CorridorKey.modifications: No upstream code modifications. Local adapter disables torch.compile and converts linear-premultiplied RGBA to straight sRGB PNG.

XSXB-Frame-Tuner.integration: Official Lite web editor and importer; project-isolated transfers of selected PNG frames. Full Godot mode and repository skill installation are not used.

compatibility_patches.framecraft-xsxb-integration-v1: Replay six audited source files for direct canvas move/scale controls, anchored PNG imports, saved tuning return and parent-window state synchronization. Validate the full source batch before writing; preserve user data and reject unknown source edits.
compatibility_patches.shared-preset-migration-revision-v1: Exclude migratedProjectIds bookkeeping from shared-preset revision hashing while preserving stale-save checks for project data and actual preset changes.
compatibility_patches.lite-fit-view-v1: Fit the Lite preview camera to the current transformed frame bounds. Does not modify animation transforms, source canvases or export data.

BiRefNet.execution: Pinned official Hugging Face remote model code, matching revision and code_revision; safetensors weights only.
